dict.string: Choose music from your library for your journey. Voice check-ins and alarms pause playback.
Saarthi watches eye closure on this phone to detect possible drowsiness. Camera frames are not recorded or uploaded.
Connect to your Mac's Saarthi voice backend on the same network.
Record your journey while Saarthi is open and share your current location when you choose. Routes stay on this phone.
Talk to Ollie and answer check-ins. Online companion turns send a short recording to Smallest.ai for transcription; offline check-ins stay on this phone.
Recognize a short driver acknowledgment using on-device speech where this language is supported.
